peptide_bioactivity.verification: Full text: KNFL identified by MALDI-TOF-TOF in a fraction of wakame protein hydrolysate; the chemically synthesized peptide (98%) has IC50 225.87 ± 2.7 µM in text; HHL substrate, rabbit-lung ACE. The paper reports no AHTPDB match.
Full text: AEYLCEAC screened from a Crassostrea gigas simulated GI digest; synthesized peptide (>95%) IC50 4.287 mM in text; HHL substrate, rabbit-lung ACE. C. gigas = Magallana gigas (WoRMS 836033).

Full text read 2026-09-28: U. prolifera protein (material from the Institute of Oceanography, CAS, Qingdao) neutral-protease hydrolysate, Sephadex G-100, <3 kDa ultrafiltrate, nano-LC-MS/MS; KAF selected by BIOPEP, ADMET and docking and synthesized (China peptides, Shanghai, purity 98%); IC50 0.63 ± 0.26 µM in the abstract, Table 1 and text; HHL 5 mM, rabbit-lung ACE (Sangon), colorimetric readout at 459 nm. Synthesis and IC50 are stated in separate sentences; KAF was never purified from natural material, so the only KAF assayed was the synthetic peptide. The sequence was matched against NCBI, not a U. prolifera proteome. No other synthetic peptide in the paper has an IC50. 3/3 verifiers passed.

Full text read 2026-09-28: market razor clams (China) hydrolysed with Actinomucor elegans T3 proteases, <3 kDa, Sephadex G-15 and two RP-HPLC steps (F7.5), MALDI-TOF/TOF de novo sequencing; VQY chemically synthesized by solid-phase technique (>98%, Chinese peptide Co., Hangzhou); IC50 9.8 µM in the abstract and Section 2.2.3, no SD given; HHL 5 mM (Cushman-Cheung, hippuric acid by RP-HPLC at 228 nm), rabbit-lung ACE (Sigma). VQY is the only synthetic peptide; IPP, VPP, VLP and YN are cited literature values. S. constricta = WoRMS 413600, published nationally as 가리맛조개. 3/3 verifiers passed.

Full text read 2026-09-28/29 (publisher HTML): 虾夷扇贝 Patinopecten yessoensis skirt (soft part excluding adductors; processing by-product, Dalian) papain hydrolysate, Sephadex LH-20 and two RP-HPLC steps (F5-3-3), ESI-MS/MS (Orbitrap Q Exactive); VW selected and 'measured after synthesis' (经合成后测定其ACE活性; no supplier, purity or method given); IC50 86.9 µmol/L in Section 2.3, both abstracts and the Discussion, no SD. The paper's only ACE assay is HHL 7.6 mmol/L in borate pH 8.3 with 608 mmol/L NaCl, hippuric acid by RP-HPLC at 228 nm; ACE from Sigma, tissue not stated. P. yessoensis (WoRMS 820198) is a superseded combination of Mizuhopecten yessoensis 393716. DOI registered with CNKI, not Crossref. 3/3 verifiers passed.

Full text read 2026-09-28: A. japonicus gonads (Ningde, Fujian) alcalase hydrolysate, <3 kDa, immobilized-ACE affinity column and RP-HPLC (A2-2), nano-LC-MS/MS with PEAKS; the 20 top-docked identified peptides were synthesized by solid phase (Kingsley, Nanjing, purity >98%); HDWWKER IC50 583.6 ± 27.6 µmol/L, the same in the abstract, Results 2.3 and Conclusions. HHL is named in Materials, the Fig. 3 legend and the kinetics section, which uses 'the same conditions as in Section 3.3'; ACE from Sigma-Aldrich, tissue not stated. Not recorded from this paper: THDWWKER (1291.8 printed as mmol/L in Results but µmol/L in the abstract and Conclusions, so the unit needs an assumption) and DDQYHIF/DDQIHIF 333.5 µM (sequence printed two ways). All 3 verifiers confirmed HDWWKER on its own; 2 failed the claim only on THDWWKER.
